provenance: Fully constructed pack (dataset-generation section 2). The claims, PBM, eligibility and conversion extracts are generated member by member from a simulation of a fictional Minnesota school district's health plan, January 2023 to March 2028; the documents were written for the fiction and converted to PDF with LibreOffice (the agreement and the renewal letter) or printed to PDF from HTML with headless Chromium (the stop-loss schedule and the implementation plan). ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, NUBC revenue, bill type and place of service codes are the real published code sets; fee schedule and charge amounts are constructed. NDCs are in 5-4-2 form on the real labeler codes of the manufacturers named; their product and package segments are constructed and are not checked against the FDA NDC Directory. NPIs and NCPDP IDs carry valid formats and check digits but belong to no real provider. No real person's or organisation's data.
